name: Weapon Designer
author: Oddisz
description: Design your own weapons from the Manage (Y) button, from the start of a campaign. Pick the mount size, mount type, damage type, projectile (ballistic, laser, beam or missile), the look of any loaded weapon (missile designs fire that launcher's own missile) and its description. Buy stats with no upper limit, bursts and ammo for guns, scripts such as lightning arcs, explosions and point defense, and scripts borrowed from any loaded weapon with design points; a share of the design points becomes the weapon's OP (LunaLib setting). Tell ship AI how to use a design with free AI hints. Saved designs join your custom production.
